messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Compilation error while running Stan on Windows 7
parts: On Wednesday, January 4, 2017 at 6:14:46 AM UTC-5, Thao Tran wrote:
Yesterday, I rerun the model and at first, it run fine but I could not use function traceplot().

What about traceplot didn't work? Was there an error message? The most common issue is that it gets masked by a traceplot function in a different package that's also loaded (coda package maybe?). You can get around that it in various ways including not masking the traceplot function, using stan_trace instead (traceplot just calls stan_trace internally), or using the mcmc_trace function in our new bayesplot package. 

Jonah

messages.subject: Re: Compilation error while running Stan on Windows 7

Ok,
I solved the problem by putting this in to Makevars file:
# created by rstan at Fri Apr 25 21:13:20 2014
CXXFLAGS = -O3 -Wall $(DEBUGFLAG) -mtune=core2     #set_by_rstan
R_XTRA_CPPFLAGS = -I"$(R_HOME)/include"      #set_by_rstan
CXXFLAGS=-O3

When running rstan, there is one notification from my antivirus program to allow rstudioapi work on my computer.
And that is all.
Thank you for your reply.
